description: Inspect curated single-cell datasets, facets, expression summaries or a scoped expression query.

action.description:
One of species, search_datasets, describe_dataset,
    dataset_facets, search_gene, query_expression.

dataset_id.description:
Required for describe_dataset, dataset_facets, and
        query_expression.

facet.description:
Optional facet name for dataset_facets, e.g. tissue,
   tissue_general, cell_type, disease, assay.

min_cells.description: Optional minimum cell count for search_datasets.

min_pct_exp.description: Optional minimum percent expressing for query_expression.

species.description: One of human, mouse, marmoset, rhesus, chimpanzee.

tissue_general.description: Optional broad tissue filter for query_expression.

name: explore_singlecell
title: Explore singlecell
